WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.

4. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

5. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.

6. When learning Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

7. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.

8. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

9. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

10. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

11. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.

12. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Timber conversion and seasoning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
